name: mbg-score
description: MBG (Mantle Bot Gate) Skill — TEE-attested on-chain risk scoring for Mantle DeFi. Installable as an OpenClaw / Byreal Skill so AI trading agents can pre-check Mantle protocol and route risk before signing, and surface a verifiable attestation hash to their user.

scripts.demo: bun run bin/mbg-cli.ts catalog list && bun run bin/mbg-cli.ts list-protocols && bun run bin/mbg-cli.ts score-protocol aave-v3-mantle && bun run bin/mbg-cli.ts score-route '[{"protocolId":"aave-v3-mantle","actionType":1,"amount":"1000"},{"protocolId":"meth-protocol","actionType":3,"amount":"500"}]'
